text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":18,"unit":"oranges","kind":"count","span":"Peter has 18 oranges"},{"id":"q2","value":27,"unit":"pears","kind":"count","span":"27 pears"},{"id":"q3","value":12,"unit":"bananas","kind":"count","span":"12 bananas"}],"plan":[{"op":"div","args":["q1","q2"],"out":"s1","note":"relates oranges and pears counts, part of finding the greatest common divisor of all three fruit counts"},{"op":"div","args":["s1","q3"],"out":"s2","note":"further relates to the banana count to complete finding the greatest common divisor (the greatest number of fruit baskets)"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"greatest number of fruit baskets Peter can make"},"dismissed":[]}
